why_provided: Preserve binding constraints so Step 6 does not recommend a trigger plan whose fallback lane is only nominal.
source_grounding: Advisor retires in 2-3 years; lab lacks single-cell experience/collaborators; Silva/data access is unproven; pressure check says option 1 may cease to be a real fallback after option-3 exploration.
contribution: Convert fallback viability and Silva/data access from soft cautions into preconditions for any trigger-based plan.
hard_boundary: Do not recommend a trigger plan unless it defines fallback executability and Silva/data access as explicit stop/go gates.
relaxation_condition: Relax only if fallback work remains finishable after the probe and Silva/data access is confirmed with named permissions, timing, and usable minimum data.
discard_condition: Discard if Step 6 is not proposing trigger-based optionality or already states both gates as hard constraints.
relation_to_bundle: Reinforces advisor-first sequencing, low-cost probing, and evidence-specific triggers by requiring operational reversibility.
risk_if_forced: May make the final answer more conservative and less elegant.
risk_if_ignored: Step 6 may endorse fictional optionality while counting unproven Silva/data access as feasibility.
